verdict.rationale: Modal's own materials say it can run very large concurrent sandbox fleets: 'hundreds of thousands of concurrent rollout environments' and 'thousands of concurrent runs'. Release notes also describe an opt-in backend with 'substantially higher creation rates and concurrency.' The pack never documents actual concurrency limits, quotas or per-account caps, so half the story is unevidenced; missing for 10: documented concurrency limits/quotas, independent or hands-on corroboration of fleet scale.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can run large concurrent fleets of sandboxes with documented concurrency limits

citations.quote: Spin up hundreds of thousands of concurrent rollout environments in seconds.
Attach to any sandbox, scale to thousands of concurrent runs, pay by the second with no reserved capacity.
it's now possible to opt into a more performant Sandbox backend, which affords substantially higher creation rates and concurrency
